copy: Copy selected walls and walls between selected points (Ctrl+C)
paste: Preview a copy, then click to place (Ctrl+V)
guide_wall: Click a start point, then click to place each wall. Press Escape to end the chain.
Click the next corner, or drag to draw a wall. Escape ends the chain.
Click to chain walls, or drag to draw. Nearby ends join automatically. Draw along a wall to extend it or fill an opening. Escape ends the chain.
guide_door: Click a wall to cut a 375 px opening. Aim near the middle between corners or branches to snap exactly to CENTER. Click an existing opening to restore the wall.
guide_eraser: Drag to erase any length of wall. Choose Brush size in the top bar. One stroke is one undo step. The fixed ship stays protected.
guide_room: Drag a room with four square corners. Hold Shift to keep width and depth equal. Start at DOOR, END or CENTER for a centered door. Free rooms use Rotate 45° or Shift + R.

Hold Shift while dragging to keep width and depth equal. Start at DOOR, END or CENTER for a centered door. Drag outward, sideways or diagonally to size the room; the adjoining side stays centered on the start. Free rooms use Rotate 45° or Shift + R.
Select Room (R) or Rectangular room (B), then enable
Release to place the room with its centered door.
Room start aligned to the {0}. Drag to size the room.
Room start aligned to the {0}. Drag toward clear space to size the room.
guide_corridor: Drag a route to draw a 580 px corridor.

Drag a route to draw a 580 px corridor. CENTER or DOOR aligns the start; from END, continue outward before turning. The ship’s outer airlock door also aligns. Finish near a target to align the endpoint while keeping your start and turn directions. Use broad turns.
Drag the route. Finish near CENTER, DOOR or END to align the endpoint automatically.
Corridor endpoint aligned to the {0}. Release to place.
Corridor start aligned to the {0}. Drag the route.
guide_hand: Drag to move around the map. Scroll to zoom at your cursor, or press F to fit the whole map.
guide_objects: Choose the type, click to set a position, aim the facing direction and click again. Select (V) to move or delete objects. Hover an NPC for advanced setup. Red objects are excluded from game generation.
guide_door_object: Choose Automatic, Sliding door or Hinged door. Hover an opening for DOOR SNAP, then click to place. Red OCCUPIED means it already has a door. Other openings stay open when this category is authored.
guide_npc: Unset fields use generator defaults. Values in parentheses describe the standard Map Manager defaults; custom generation profiles may differ. Choose Patrol points (manual) to place a route on the map.
guide_route: Choose how many points to place, then click them on the map in order. Numbered points are visible only while configuring the route. Escape cancels and keeps the previous route.
guide_generate: Generate gameplay objects with Map Manager defaults. Categories with valid placements are kept.
Optional: categories without valid objects are generated automatically.
replacement: Map geometry or generation defaults have changed. All existing gameplay objects, including hand-placed objects, will be removed and new objects created with Map Manager defaults.
save_first: Save your map first if you want to keep your changes.
flip_hint: Flip the ship while keeping the airlock in place.
included: Included in game generation. Drag to move; Delete removes it.
ready: Revola map editor ready. Save maps here, then Save and launch to test.
changed: Manual patrol route saved. Route markers are hidden.
NPC overrides saved. Unset fields inherit generator defaults.
Room rotation set to 45°. Drag on the canvas to place it.
Ship mirrored. Airlock connection stays in place.
Wall drawn. Nearby ends joined; covered openings filled.
Wall erased. Draw over the gap to restore it.
Wall placed. Continue drawing or press Escape.
Release to apply. Connected walls keep their directions.
placed: Corridor placed from the corridor end.
Corridor placed from the door center.
Corridor placed from the wall midpoint. Use the Door tool to open the wall.
Corridor placed. Use the Door tool to connect through existing walls.
Rectangular room placed. Drag a side to resize it.
Room placed with its door at the {0}.
Room placed. Drag a side to resize it while keeping its chamfers.
selected: Area selected. Ctrl-click to adjust; drag a selected item to move.
Selection updated. Drag a selected item to move the group.
copied: Copied {0} walls and their openings. Ctrl+V to place a copy.
pasted: Pasted {0} walls. The copy is selected. Ctrl+V to place another.
close_floor: Close the map before generating gameplay objects.
Floor generation requires a closed map.
Close the map to validate gameplay objects.
floor_open: Open map: an exterior wall has {0}. Close it before generating the floor.
Open map: the ship can reach the exterior through a doorway, erased gap or unfinished wall.
too_dense: Floor closure analysis exceeds the supported 2,000,000 nearby intersection checks.
Floor courtyard analysis exceeds the supported 2,000,000 boundary-point checks.
Floor exterior-opening analysis exceeds the supported 2,000,000 boundary-point checks.

map_changed: The generated floor no longer matches the map bounds. Generate it again.
The map changed. No generated objects were applied.
The map changed. Press Generate objects again.
no_space: No new objects fit. Categories with valid objects are kept; other categories still use Map Manager generation.
No walkable floor fits this map.
size_limit: Generated objects would exceed the 4096-object project limit.

need_opening: Aim at an existing door opening. Door objects snap to openings.
Move the door onto an unoccupied opening.
door_space: A doorway is too close to a wall endpoint.
There is not enough room for a door here. Keep clear of corners and other doors.
overlap: Coincident vertices must share one graph identifier.

Intersecting walls must be split at a shared graph vertex.
Overlapping walls must form separate segments with shared graph vertices.

Select walls or connected points to copy.
place_first: Place patrol point 1 of {0}. Click playable floor; Escape keeps the previous route.

object_overlap: Object centers overlap (less than 45 px apart).
object_outside: Object center is outside playable floor or inside a wall.
opening_missing: The door opening no longer exists.
guide_pad: Right stick: cursor · Action / Attack: click or hold to drag · Left stick: pan · D-pad: scroll / zoom · RB: pan with cursor · Utility: back
object_stats: {0} objects · {1} valid · {2} excluded. Categories with valid objects replace automatic placement.
guide_select: Click a point or wall to select. Ctrl-click toggles; drag empty space for an area. Drag the selection to move it. Delete removes selected walls/points. Ctrl+C copies; Ctrl+V previews a separate copy.

Drag an area or Ctrl-click points/walls. Ctrl+C copies their walls and openings. Ctrl+V previews a copy; move the pointer and click to place, or Escape to cancel. Drag selected items to move them. A single room side still resizes.
paste_hint: Click to place the copy. Escape cancels. Ctrl+V starts another copy after placement.
blocked_hint: Cannot paste here: {0} Move the pointer, or Escape to cancel.
